column1: # SNP barcode of the livestock-associated M. tuberculosis complex (La1: M. bovis, La2: M. caprae, La3: M. orygis)
# and of the La1 sublineages, from Zwyer M et al. A new nomenclature for the livestock-associated Mycobacterium
# tuberculosis complex based on phylogenomics. Open Research Europe 1:100 (2021).
# the 89 SNPs marked "KvarQ_informative" (one left out, below). Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license.
# Positions on the H37Rv reference genome NC_000962.3 (and on the MTBC ancestor of the paper, which has the same
# coordinates). group: the lineage or sublineage defined by the derived allele; La1_La2: shared by La1 and La2;
# La1.2_BCG: the BCG strains, within La1.2. Left out: La1.1 2339255 (G>A), whose derived allele H37Rv also carries.
